a.name: Answer ledger
a.description: Maggie's photo left; right, the question, its answer and five ruled rows of a caps label and one sentence, under a steel rule.
a.differs_from: Labelled ruled rows beside a photo, framed by rules; the built takeaways are imageless cards stacked, in a grid on a band, or in a rail.

b.name: Tick card
b.description: One raised card with a wide photo of Ince across its top, then four large-type ticked lines and an Ask pill.
b.differs_from: A single raised card holding a photo and a tick list; the built takeaways are several imageless cards on the page or on a band.

c.name: Numbered decisions
c.description: A sunk steel-100 panel: three decisions with large display numerals beside a tall photo of Cheryl filling the right side.
c.differs_from: Three numbered decisions in a sunk panel beside a photo; the built takeaways have no photo and sit plain or on a band.
